Typhoon Kalmaegi struck the central Philippines, causing widespread flooding, destructive winds, and significant loss of life. 

At least 66 dead, with 26 others still missing, primarily in Cebu province where flooding trapped residents on rooftops and swept away vehicles. https://t.co/g618QYZnoS

🌍 Global Security Outlook – 05 Nov 2025

⸻

AFRICA

🇨🇲 Cameroon – Security forces killed 48 civilians during election protests against President Paul Biya’s re-election, according to UN sources.
🇨🇩 DR Congo – The AFC/M23 rebellion has established a parallel justice system in North Kivu, condemned as illegal by Kinshasa.
🇹🇿 Tanzania – Authorities lifted the Dar es Salaam curfew following days of post-election unrest; stability is slowly returning.

⸻

EAST ASIA & PACIFIC

🇯🇵 Japan – Troops deployed to northern regions amid a deadly surge in bear attacks overwhelming local authorities.
🇵🇭 Philippines – Over 100 people confirmed dead after Typhoon Kalmaegi caused severe flooding in Cebu, marking one of the worst natural disasters in years.

⸻

EUROPE

🇫🇷 France – A driver rammed pedestrians and cyclists on Oleron Island, injuring nine before being apprehended.
🇷🇺 Russia / 🇺🇦 Ukraine – Russian forces advanced deeper into Pokrovsk, claiming to clear remaining Ukrainian troops from this key logistics hub.

⸻

MIDDLE EAST & NORTH AFRICA

🇮🇷 Iran – Two French nationals were freed under “Islamic clemency” but remain in Iran pending travel clearance.
🇮🇶 Iraq – Prime Minister Mohammed Shia Al-Sudani positions himself as the frontrunner for re-election, consolidating control over rival factions.

⸻

SOUTH & CENTRAL ASIA

🇧🇩 Bangladesh – Health authorities recorded the year’s highest dengue toll, with 10 deaths and 1,069 new infections in a single day.
🇵🇰 Pakistan – The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government will convene a peace jirga on November 12 to address security challenges with political and civil leaders.

⸻

WESTERN HEMISPHERE

🇧🇷 Brazil – The deadliest police raid in national history leaves President Lula facing international condemnation over human rights abuses.
🇨🇷 Costa Rica – A massive anti-narcotics operation targeted the “South Caribbean Cartel,” deploying 1,200 officers in the largest crackdown in the nation’s history.
🇭🇹 Haiti / 🇨🇺 Cuba / 🇯🇲 Jamaica – Hurricane Melissa death toll climbs to 43 in Haiti; regional aid and recovery efforts continue across the northern Caribbean.
🇲🇽 Mexico – President Sheinbaum unveils a new security plan for Michoacán after public outrage over a mayor’s assassination—the seventh in three years.

🌀 Typhoon Kalmaegi (“Tino”) intensifies again over the South China Sea 🇻🇳

After crossing the Philippines with winds up to 148 km/h, Kalmaegi left behind fatalities and 175,000+ evacuations, including in areas hit by a 6.9 earthquake just days earlier.

Now moving west-northwest toward Vietnam, it’s forecast to make landfall Thursday night into Friday between Da Nang and Nha Trang with winds up to 175 km/h and gusts 210 km/h.

⚠️ Vietnam hazards: 200–400 mm of rain, destructive winds, storm surge, and high waves up to 8 m.
Flooding and landslides likely in coastal and mountainous regions.
